# Design Sojourn

> A Singapore-based design consultancy specializing in human-centred design thinking, innovation strategy, and digital transformation for enterprise clients.

Design Sojourn, founded by Brian Ling, helps organizations solve complex problems through design-led innovation and service design methodologies. The firm emphasizes that technology alone cannot drive meaningful transformation—human-centred design and ethnographic research are essential to sustainable business innovation.

## Key Topics

- Design Thinking
- Human-Centred Design
- Service Design
- Business Model Innovation
- Design-Led Innovation
- Digital Transformation
- Experience Design
- Ethnographic Research
- Customer Experience
- Design Methodology
- Design Process
- Transformation Strategy
- User Research
- Design Consultancy
- Singapore
